<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Teja Testy's Restaurant</title>

<style>
*{
    box-sizing:border-box;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    font-family:Arial,sans-serif;
}

body{
    background:#fff8ef;
    color:#222;
}

button{
    border:0;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:12px 18px;
    font-weight:bold;
}

input{
    width:100%;
    padding:13px;
    margin:7px 0;
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:8px;
    font-size:15px;
}

/* LOGIN */

#loginPage{
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:
    linear-gradient(#0008,#0008),
    url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517248135467-4c7edcad34c4?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80");
    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
}

.login-box{
    width:380px;
    max-width:92%;
    background:white;
    padding:30px;
    border-radius:20px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 40px #0008;
    text-align:center;
}

.login-box h1{
    color:#e65100;
    margin-bottom:8px;
}

.login-box p{
    color:#777;
    margin-bottom:18px;
}

.login-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
    margin-top:8px;
}

.create-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:#ff9800;
    color:white;
}

.back-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:#ddd;
    margin-top:8px;
}

/* PASSWORD */

.password-box{
    position:relative;
}

.password-box input{
    padding-right:55px;
}

.eye-btn{
    position:absolute;
    right:4px;
    top:10px;
    padding:6px 10px;
    background:transparent;
    font-size:18px;
}

/* APP */

#app{
    display:none;
    min-height:100vh;
}

header{
    height:70px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e65100,#ff9800);
    color:white;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:0 20px;
    gap:15px;
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:10;
}

.menu-btn{
    background:white;
    color:#e65100;
    font-size:25px;
    padding:5px 12px;
}

header h1{
    font-size:25px;
}

/* SIDEBAR */

#sidebar{
    position:fixed;
    left:-270px;
    top:70px;
    width:250px;
    height:calc(100vh - 70px);
    background:#222;
    z-index:30;
    padding:20px 10px;
    transition:.3s;
}

#sidebar.open{
    left:0;
}

#sidebar button{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    text-align:left;
    background:#333;
    color:white;
}

#sidebar button:hover{
    background:#e65100;
}

/* MAIN */

main{
    padding:25px;
}

.hero{
    background:
    linear-gradient(#0008,#0008),
    url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1504674900247-0877df9cc836?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80");
    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
    color:white;
    padding:55px 25px;
    border-radius:18px;
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.hero h2{
    font-size:38px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
}

/* CATEGORIES */

.categories{
    display:flex;
    gap:8px;
    overflow-x:auto;
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.categories button{
    white-space:nowrap;
    background:#ffe0b2;
    color:#e65100;
}

.categories button.active,
.categories button:hover{
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
}

/* FOOD */

.food-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));
    gap:20px;
}

.food-card{
    background:white;
    border-radius:15px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 4px 15px #0002;
    transition:.2s;
}

.food-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-5px);
}

.food-card img{
    width:100%;
    height:170px;
    object-fit:cover;
}

.food-info{
    padding:15px;
}

.food-info h3{
    margin-bottom:8px;
}

.price{
    color:#e65100;
    font-weight:bold;
    font-size:19px;
    margin:8px 0;
}

.add-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
}

/* CART */

.cart-float{
    position:fixed;
    right:20px;
    bottom:20px;
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
    padding:15px 22px;
    border-radius:50px;
    box-shadow:0 5px 20px #0005;
    cursor:pointer;
    z-index:20;
}

/* MODAL */

.modal{
    display:none;
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:#0009;
    z-index:100;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:15px;
}

.modal-content{
    background:white;
    width:600px;
    max-width:100%;
    max-height:90vh;
    overflow:auto;
    padding:25px;
    border-radius:15px;
}

.modal-content h2{
    color:#e65100;
    margin-bottom:18px;
}

.close{
    float:right;
    background:#eee;
}

.primary{
    width:100%;
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
    margin-top:10px;
}

/* CART ITEMS */

.cart-item{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;
    padding:12px 0;
}

.qty button{
    background:#ffcc80;
    padding:5px 10px;
}

.total{
    color:#e65100;
    font-size:22px;
    font-weight:bold;
    margin:20px 0;
}

/* PAYMENT */

.payment-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    gap:10px;
    margin-top:15px;
}

.payment-grid button{
    background:#f3f3f3;
    border:2px solid #ddd;
}

.payment-grid button.selected{
    background:#e65100;
    color:white;
    border-color:#e65100;
}

/* SUCCESS */

.success{
    text-align:center;
    padding:30px;
}

.success h2{
    color:#2e7d32;
    font-size:30px;
}

footer{
    text-align:center;
    padding:25px;
    color:#777;
}

/* MOBILE */

@media(max-width:600px){

    header h1{
        font-size:18px;
    }

    main{
        padding:15px;
    }

    .hero h2{
        font-size:28px;
    }

    .payment-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }
}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<!-- =====================================================
                     LOGIN PAGE
====================================================== -->

<section id="loginPage">

<div class="login-box">

<h1>🍴 Venni Tasty's</h1>

<p>Restaurant Food Management</p>


<!-- LOGIN -->

<div id="loginForm">

<input
type="email"
id="loginEmail"
placeholder="Enter Email">


<div class="password-box">

<input
type="password"
id="loginPassword"
placeholder="Enter Password">

<button
class="eye-btn"
onclick="togglePassword('loginPassword','loginEye')"
id="loginEye">
👁️
</button>

</div>


<button
class="login-btn"
onclick="login()">
LOGIN
</button>


<p style="margin-top:20px;">
Don't have an account?
</p>


<button
class="create-btn"
onclick="showCreateAccount()">
➕ CREATE NEW ACCOUNT
</button>

</div>


<!-- CREATE ACCOUNT -->

<div
id="createAccountForm"
style="display:none;">

<h2 style="color:#e65100;">
Create New Account
</h2>

<input
id="newName"
placeholder="Full Name">

<input
id="newEmail"
type="email"
placeholder="Email Address">


<div class="password-box">

<input
id="newPassword"
type="password"
placeholder="Create Password">

<button
class="eye-btn"
onclick="togglePassword('newPassword','newEye')"
id="newEye">
👁️
</button>

</div>


<div class="password-box">

<input
id="confirmPassword"
type="password"
placeholder="Confirm Password">

<button
class="eye-btn"
onclick="togglePassword('confirmPassword','confirmEye')"
id="confirmEye">
👁️
</button>

</div>


<button
class="login-btn"
onclick="createAccount()">
CREATE ACCOUNT
</button>


<button
class="back-btn"
onclick="showLogin()">
← BACK TO LOGIN
</button>

</div>

</div>

</section>


<!-- =====================================================
                    MAIN APP
====================================================== -->

<section id="app">

<header>

<button
class="menu-btn"
onclick="toggleMenu()">
☰
</button>

<h1>🍴 Venni Tasty's Restaurant</h1>

</header>


<!-- SIDEBAR -->

<aside id="sidebar">

<button onclick="showHome()">
🍽️ Food Menu
</button>

<button onclick="showAbout()">
ℹ️ About
</button>

<button onclick="showProfile()">
👤 Profile
</button>

<button onclick="openCart()">
🛒 Orders / Cart
</button>

<button onclick="logout()">
🚪 Logout
</button>

</aside>


<!-- MAIN CONTENT -->

<main>

<section class="hero">

<h2>Welcome to Venni Tasty's</h2>

<p>
Delicious Food • Fresh Ingredients • Fast Service
</p>

</section>


<!-- FOOD CATEGORIES -->

<div class="categories">

<button
class="active"
onclick="filterFood('Veg',this)">
🥗 Veg
</button>

<button
onclick="filterFood('Non-Veg',this)">
🍗 Non-Veg
</button>

onclick="filterFood('Curries',this)">

</button>

<div
id="foodGrid"
class="food-grid">
</div>


<footer>
© 2026 Venni Tasty's Restaurant
<br>
Thank You, Visit Again ❤️
</footer>

</main>


<!-- FLOAT CART -->

<div
class="cart-float"
onclick="openCart()">

🛒 Cart:
<span id="cartCount">0</span>

</div>

</section>


<!-- =====================================================
                       CART MODAL
====================================================== -->

<div
class="modal"
id="cartModal">

<div class="modal-content">

<button
class="close"
onclick="closeModal('cartModal')">
✕
</button>

<h2>🛒 Your Cart</h2>

<div id="cartItems"></div>

<div class="total">
Total: ₹<span id="cartTotal">0</span>
</div>

<button
class="primary"
onclick="startOrder()">
Continue to Order
</button>

</div>

</div>


<!-- =====================================================
                  CUSTOMER DETAILS
====================================================== -->

<div
class="modal"
id="customerModal">

<div class="modal-content">

<button
class="close"
onclick="closeModal('customerModal')">
✕
</button>

id="customerPhone"
placeholder="Phone Number"

id="otpInput"

class="primary"

</div>

====================================================== -->

class="modal"
id="addressModal">

class="close"
onclick="closeModal('addressModal')">
✕
</button>

<input
id="address"
placeholder="Full Address">

<input
id="landmark"
placeholder="Landmark">

<input
id="location"
placeholder="Location / City">

<button
class="primary"
onclick="saveAddress()">
Continue to Payment
</button>

</div>

</div>


<!-- =====================================================
                       PAYMENT
====================================================== -->

<div
class="modal"
id="paymentModal">

<div class="modal-content">

<button
class="close"
onclick="closeModal('paymentModal')">
✕
</button>

<h2>💳 Select Payment Method</h2>

<p>
Total Amount:
<strong>
₹<span id="paymentAmount">0</span>
</strong>
</p>


<div class="payment-grid">

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'PhonePe')">
🟣 PhonePe
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'Google Pay')">
🔵 Google Pay
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'Paytm')">
🔷 Paytm
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'UPI')">
🟢 UPI
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'Net Banking')">
🏦 Net Banking
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'Debit Card')">
💳 Debit Card
</button>

<button onclick="selectPayment(this,'Cash on Delivery')">
💵 Cash on Delivery
</button>

</div>


<!-- PAYMENT / QR AREA -->

<div
id="paymentBox"
style="
display:none;
text-align:center;
margin-top:25px;
padding:20px;
background:#fafafa;
border-radius:15px;
">

<h3 id="paymentTitle"></h3>

<p style="margin:10px 0;">
Scan the QR code using your payment app
</p>


<div id="qrcode"></div>


<p>
UPI Number:
<strong>7032104891</strong>
</p>


<p style="color:#777;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">
Amount:
₹<span id="qrAmount">0</span>
</p>


<button
class="primary"
onclick="confirmOrder()">
✅ Payment Done
</button>

</div>

</div>

</div>



<!-- =====================================================
                    SUCCESS
====================================================== -->

<div
class="modal"
id="successModal">

<div class="modal-content success">

<h2>
🎉 ORDER CONFIRMED!
</h2>

<p style="margin:20px 0;">

Thank you for ordering from
<strong>Venni Tasty's</strong>.

</p>

<p>
Your delicious food is being prepared.
</p>

<h3 style="margin:20px;">
Thank You, Visit Again ❤️
</h3>


<button
class="primary"
onclick="continueShopping()">
Continue Shopping
</button>


<button
style="width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:#ddd;"
onclick="backToMenu()">
← Back to Main Menu
</button>

</div>

</div>


<!-- =====================================================
                       JAVASCRIPT
====================================================== -->

<script>

/* ==============================
      ACCOUNT
============================== */

let registeredUser =
JSON.parse(
localStorage.getItem("VenniTastysUser")
) || null;


function showCreateAccount(){

document.getElementById("loginForm")
.style.display="none";

document.getElementById("createAccountForm")
.style.display="block";

}


function showLogin(){

document.getElementById("createAccountForm")
.style.display="none";

document.getElementById("loginForm")
.style.display="block";

}


function togglePassword(inputId,eyeId){

let input =
document.getElementById(inputId);

let eye =
document.getElementById(eyeId);

if(input.type==="password"){

input.type="text";
eye.innerText="🙈";

}else{

input.type="password";
eye.innerText="👁️";

}

}


/* CREATE ACCOUNT */

function createAccount(){

let name =
document.getElementById("newName")
.value.trim();

let email =
document.getElementById("newEmail")
.value.trim();

let password =
document.getElementById("newPassword")
.value;

let confirm =
document.getElementById("confirmPassword")
.value;


if(!name || !email || !password || !confirm){

alert("Please fill all fields.");
return;

}


let emailPattern =
/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;


if(!emailPattern.test(email)){

alert("Please enter valid email.");
return;

}


if(password.length<5){

alert("Password must contain at least 5 characters.");
return;

}


if(password!==confirm){

alert("Passwords do not match.");
return;

}


registeredUser={
name:name,
email:email,
password:password
};


localStorage.setItem(
"tejaTestysUser",
JSON.stringify(registeredUser)
);


alert(
"🎉 Account created successfully!"
);


document.getElementById("loginEmail")
.value=email;


document.getElementById("newName")
.value="";

document.getElementById("newEmail")
.value="";

document.getElementById("newPassword")
.value="";

document.getElementById("confirmPassword")
.value="";


showLogin();

}


/* LOGIN */

function login(){

let email =
document.getElementById("loginEmail")
.value.trim();

let password =
document.getElementById("loginPassword")
.value;


/* CREATED ACCOUNT */

if(
registeredUser &&
email===registeredUser.email &&
password===registeredUser.password
){

openApp();
return;

}


/* DEFAULT ADMIN */

if(
email==="venni@tasty.com" &&
password==="vennila"
){

openApp();

}else{

alert(
"❌ Wrong Email or Password"
);

}

}


function openApp(){

document.getElementById("loginPage")
.style.display="none";

document.getElementById("app")
.style.display="block";

loadFoods();

}


/* ==============================
        SIDEBAR
============================== */

function toggleMenu(){

document
.getElementById("sidebar")
.classList.toggle("open");

}


function logout(){

location.reload();

}

img:"https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQPYABi-7Pr6S1w-LqkNFRujtYsA7fxOZJ9xDa-Mr6Rfg&s=10"
},

{
name:"Vanilla Ice Cream",
cat:"Ice Creams",
price:90,
img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1570197788417-0e82375c9371?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
},

{
name:"Chocolate Ice Cream",
cat:"Ice Creams",
price:100,
img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563805042-7684c019e1cb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
},

{
name:"Strawberry Ice Cream",
cat:"Ice Creams",
price:110,
img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497034825429-c343d7c6a68f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
}

];


/* ==============================
          FOOD MENU
============================== */

let cart=[];

function loadFoods(){

filterFood("Veg");

}


function filterFood(category,button){

if(button){

document
.querySelectorAll(".categories button")
.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));

button.classList.add("active");

}

let grid=
document.getElementById("foodGrid");

grid.innerHTML="";


foods
.filter(food=>food.cat===category)
.forEach(food=>{

grid.innerHTML+=`

<div class="food-card">

<img src="${food.img}">

<div class="food-info">

<h3>${food.name}</h3>

<div class="price">
₹${food.price}
</div>

<button
class="add-btn"
onclick="addToCart('${food.name}')">
Add to Cart 🛒
</button>

</div>

</div>

`;

});

}


/* ADD CART */

function addToCart(name){

let food=
foods.find(f=>f.name===name);

let item=
cart.find(f=>f.name===name);

if(item){

item.qty++;

}else{

cart.push({
...food,
qty:1
});

}

updateCart();

alert(
food.name+" added to cart 🛒"
);

}


function updateCart(){

let count=
cart.reduce(
(total,item)=>total+item.qty,
0
);

document.getElementById("cartCount")
.innerText=count;

}


function openCart(){

document.getElementById("cartModal")
.style.display="flex";

renderCart();

}


function renderCart(){

let box=
document.getElementById("cartItems");

box.innerHTML="";

let total=0;


if(cart.length===0){

box.innerHTML=
"<p>Your cart is empty.</p>";

}


cart.forEach((item,index)=>{

total+=item.price*item.qty;

box.innerHTML+=`

<div class="cart-item">

<div>
<strong>${item.name}</strong>
<br>
₹${item.price} × ${item.qty}
</div>

<div class="qty">

<button onclick="changeQty(${index},-1)">
−
</button>

${item.qty}

<button onclick="changeQty(${index},1)">
+
</button>

</div>

</div>

`;

});


document.getElementById("cartTotal")
.innerText=total;

}


function changeQty(index,value){

cart[index].qty+=value;

if(cart[index].qty<=0){

cart.splice(index,1);

}

updateCart();

renderCart();

}


/* ==============================
          ORDER
============================== */

function startOrder(){

if(cart.length===0){

alert("Please add food items first.");

return;

}

closeModal("cartModal");

document.getElementById("customerModal")
.style.display="flex";

}


/* ==============================
            OTP
============================== */

let generatedOTP="";


function sendOTP(){

let name=
document.getElementById("customerName")
.value.trim();

let phone=
document.getElementById("customerPhone")
.value.trim();


if(!name || phone.length!==10){

alert(
"Enter valid name and 10 digit phone number."
);

return;

}


generatedOTP=
Math.floor(
100000+
Math.random()*900000
).toString();


document.getElementById("otpArea")
.style.display="block";


alert(
"Demo OTP: "+generatedOTP+
"\n\nReal SMS requires SMS API."
);

}


function verifyOTP(){

let otp=
document.getElementById("otpInput")
.value.trim();


if(otp===generatedOTP){

alert("OTP Verified ✅");

closeModal("customerModal");

document.getElementById("addressModal")
.style.display="flex";

}else{

alert("❌ Wrong OTP");

}

}


/* ==============================
           ADDRESS
============================== */

function saveAddress(){

let address=
document.getElementById("address")
.value.trim();

let landmark=
document.getElementById("landmark")
.value.trim();

let location=
document.getElementById("location")
.value.trim();


if(!address || !landmark || !location){

alert(
"Please enter complete address details."
);

return;

}


closeModal("addressModal");


let total=
cart.reduce(
(sum,item)=>
sum+(item.price*item.qty),
0
);


document.getElementById("paymentAmount")
.innerText=total;


document.getElementById("paymentModal")
.style.display="flex";

}


/* ==============================
            PAYMENT
============================== */

let selectedPayment="";


function selectPayment(button,payment){

selectedPayment=payment;


document
.querySelectorAll(".payment-grid button")
.forEach(b=>
b.classList.remove("selected")
);


button.classList.add("selected");


let box=
document.getElementById("paymentBox");


box.style.display="block";


if(payment==="Cash on Delivery"){

box.innerHTML=`

<h3>💵 Cash on Delivery</h3>

<p style="margin:15px 0;">
Pay cash when your food is delivered.
</p>

<button
class="primary"
onclick="confirmOrder()">
Confirm COD Order
</button>

`;

}else{

box.innerHTML=`

<h3>💳 ${payment}</h3>

<div style="
background:#f5f5f5;
padding:20px;
border-radius:10px;
margin:15px 0;">

<p>Demo UPI / PhonePe Number</p>

<h2>8309719275</h2>

<p style="color:#777;margin-top:10px;">
Demo payment mode
</p>

</div>

<button
class="primary"
onclick="confirmOrder()">
Payment Done ✓
</button>

`;

}

}


/* ==============================
        CONFIRM ORDER
============================== */

function confirmOrder(){

if(!selectedPayment){

alert("Please select payment method.");

return;

}

closeModal("paymentModal");

document.getElementById("successModal")
.style.display="flex";

}


/* ==============================
        CONTINUE
============================== */

function continueShopping(){

cart=[];

updateCart();

closeModal("successModal");

showHome();

}


function backToMenu(){

closeModal("successModal");

showHome();

}


/* ==============================
          ABOUT
============================== */

function showAbout(){

document.getElementById("foodGrid")
.innerHTML=`

<div style="
background:white;
padding:30px;
border-radius:15px;
grid-column:1/-1;
box-shadow:0 4px 15px #0002;">

<h2 style="color:#e65100;">
About Teja Testy's
</h2>

<p style="line-height:1.8;margin-top:15px;">

Welcome to <strong>Venni Tasty's Restaurant</strong>.
We serve delicious vegetarian and non-vegetarian
food, curries, meals, drinks and desserts.

</p>

</div>

`;

}


/* ==============================
          PROFILE
============================== */

function showProfile(){

let user=
registeredUser
?registeredUser.name
:"Admin";


document.getElementById("foodGrid")
.innerHTML=`

<div style="
background:white;
padding:30px;
border-radius:15px;
grid-column:1/-1;
box-shadow:0 4px 15px #0002;">

<h2 style="color:#e65100;">
👤 Profile
</h2>

<p style="margin-top:15px;">
Name: <strong>${user}</strong>
</p>

<p style="margin-top:10px;">
Restaurant: <strong>Venni Tasty's</strong>
</p>

<p style="margin-top:10px;">
Phone: 8309719275
</p>

</div>

`;

}


/* ==============================
             HOME
============================== */

function showHome(){

document.querySelector(".hero")
.style.display="block";

document.querySelector(".categories")
.style.display="flex";

filterFood("Veg");

}


/* ==============================
          CLOSE MODAL
============================== */

function closeModal(id){

document.getElementById(id)
.style.display="none";

}

</script>

</body>
</html>
